Grid landing pages (Ministerio Liderazgo, Liturgia, Finanzas, Mantenimiento, Formacion en la Fe) were filled with a directory/staff-grid instruction summarizing their listed members, since no separate landing intro copy was given in the PDF.
'Create and Parish will review' instructions were treated as sufficient content direction (draft new content, flag for parish review) rather than a blocker requiring human input.

Per Solutio Building Notes: avoid photos of children on any grid/member page unless directly requested or supplied by the client; Facebook admin contact is Cristy for pulling social bios/photos; client uses Microsoft Outlook (relevant for any email-based workflows, e.g., sacramental record requests).

Funerales | Funerals content (both under Liturgia and under Formacion en la Fe) assumed to carry the same workflow note: families should contact the funeral home directly, which then contacts the parish — not a parish-initiated intake form.
